name: AgePad
game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition (PC, Mac edition on Steam)

macos.text: Known problem: AgePad 0.1.0 can stop when Steam has updated its files since that release, because its recipe expects the older Steam files. A fix is in progress (https://github.com/chrissotraidis/agepad/pull/15); check it before installing the tools.

es.text: Problema conocido: AgePad 0.1.0 puede detenerse si Steam actualizó sus archivos después de esa versión, porque su receta espera los archivos anteriores de Steam. Hay una corrección en curso (https://github.com/chrissotraidis/agepad/pull/15); revísala antes de instalar las herramientas.

pt.text: Problema conhecido: o AgePad 0.1.0 pode parar se o Steam atualizou os arquivos depois dessa versão, porque a receita espera os arquivos antigos do Steam. Uma correção está em andamento (https://github.com/chrissotraidis/agepad/pull/15); confira antes de instalar as ferramentas.

notes: Manifest owned by the game repository. The published base app is AgePad's own code; the inject step adds the player's own Mac game program and Steam files, found in Steam's folders on this Mac (no file to choose, no Xcode). The 20 GB game data folder is copied to the iPad afterwards. iPad with 8 GB or more only.
